title: Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.21055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they read datasets and evaluation results, build their training data, write and modify training algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and analyze the results to decide what to try next. They work in a sandbox and cannot use external teacher models. translated_title: Athanor：一个面向自主后训练研究的智能体原生系统
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进，即AI系统构建更强大的AI系统，是通往超级智能的一条有前景的路径。我们研究了一种如今即可测量的较弱形式：前沿智能体使用公开数据对一个小型原始基础模型进行后训练，以此作为对其研究潜力的测试。我们构建了Athanor，一个运行在真实GPU上的开放式智能体原生自主后训练研究系统（AutoPostTrain）。我们为智能体提供了完全的研究自主权、低摩擦的工程工具以及高效的起始代码。智能体自行开展研究：它们阅读数据集和评估结果，构建训练数据，编写并修改训练算法，调整超参数，并分析结果以决定下一步的尝试。它们在沙箱环境中工作，且无法使用外部教师模型。Athanor的服务提供冻结评估、托管任务、去污染数据、持久化研究记录，以及一套智能体不知情的保留测试套件。
tldr: Athanor是一个开放的智能体原生系统，赋予AI智能体完全的研究自主权，让它们在真实GPU上自主完成小型基础模型的后训练研究，以此检验智能体迈向递归自我改进的研究潜力。
en_tdlr: Athanor is an open agent-native system that grants AI agents full research autonomy to autonomously conduct post-training research on small base models using real GPUs, testing their research potential toward recursive self-improvement.
